text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E in stages helped me realize gains while retaining exposure; I should keep sizing sales according to my plan, not just the pleasure of locking in a profit.","I added to four stocks in one period, then my account fell; I should check position sizes and portfolio risk before committing cash, without treating the decline as a forecast.","My average cost and recent price history can influence how trades feel, but neither predicts what comes next; I should make each buy, sell, or hold decision using my current plan and risk limits."]}
